description:
A local-first workspace for teams of AI agents.

Autohand Squad is a local-first workspace for agent teams. It runs a local runtime, desktop controller, analytics, and release pipeline so you can work with your dream team of AI agents.
Stable release. Recommended for everyone.
Source: c8bb30098eb8
What's new
Fixed
- Install and restart works again on macOS while another app (such as Autohand Desktop) is using Squad's MCP server. Before, Squad quietly opened the installer instead of updating in place. Updating from 0.1.22 or 0.1.23 still needs those apps closed first, or the installer.
